My Balanced Day.description: Build an after-school routine with time for screens, play, learning and rest.

Pop-Up Safety Simulator.description: A surprise pops up on your screen. Practise spotting the safest thing to do next.

Smart Tech Habits Quiz.description: Put your everyday tech choices to the test and discover habits that help you thrive.

Info Sorter.description: Sort information into what is safe to share, what needs a grown-up, and what stays private.

Share Circles.description: Think about who is asking before you decide what to share. Every choice matters.

Safe Username Maker.description: Create a pretend username that is fun, kind and keeps personal details out of sight.

Password Lab.description: Mix made-up words, numbers and symbols to investigate what makes a password stronger.

Account Guard.description: Make thoughtful choices in everyday account situations and keep your digital world safe.

Photo Clue Detective.description: Look closely at a picture and find the little clues that could reveal personal information.

Post or Pause.description: Before you post, take a moment. Decide what is thoughtful, safe and ready to share.

Privacy Champion Quiz.description: Bring your privacy skills together in twelve questions. How much have you discovered?

Cool It Down.description: An online conversation is heating up. Choose calmer replies and watch the temperature fall.

Message Makeover Studio.description: Give a tricky message a fresh start. Rewrite it so it feels clearer, kinder and more thoughtful.

Group Chat Sandbox.description: Join a pretend team conversation and practise responding with care and confidence.

Sort It Board.description: Is it a joke, a conflict or bullying? Sort the situations and think about what makes them different.

Red Flag Detective.description: Read pretend messages and uncover suspicious details before they catch you out.

Encryption Machine.description: Turn a made-up message into a secret code and watch how each letter changes with a key.

Decoder Machine.description: Explore how a coded message becomes readable again by working through the alphabet.

Cyber Castle.description: Choose protections for your digital castle and discover how different defences work together.

Virus Outbreak.description: Try different protections and see how they change a simulated outbreak on class computers.

URL Detective.description: Investigate web addresses, spot lookalike sites and build your own safe-link checklist.

Beat the Trickster.description: Look past tempting tricks and practise recognising the signs of an online scam.

App Permission Checker.description: Decide which permissions an app really needs and take a closer look at what it asks to access.

Password Cracker.description: Test pretend passwords against simulated guessing methods and explore why length matters.

Two-Step Login.description: Try both sides of a pretend login and discover the difference an extra security step can make.

Network Explorer.description: Follow a pretend message across a network and compare what happens with and without encryption.

Photo Edit Lab.description: Change a scene, compare it with the original and discover why pictures deserve a closer look.

Rumour Spread Simulator.description: Watch how a story travels. Practise checking information before you decide to pass it on.

Cyber Crime Scene.description: Piece together the clues behind a pretend account hack, build a timeline and solve the case.

Cyber Defence HQ.description: Plan your school's digital defences, test them against an attack wave and strengthen the gaps.

Inbox Inspector.description: Inspect senders, links and attachments to separate trusted messages from phishing.

Phone Trap.description: Spot traps in text messages, phone calls and QR codes, and choose a trusted way to check.

File Inspector.description: Reveal file extensions and details to decide what is safe to open, delete or ask about.

Firewall Gatekeeper.description: Set firewall rules and balance welcoming real visitors with stopping unwanted traffic.

Ransomware Outbreak.description: Choose school defences, watch a simulated attack and practise recovery decisions.

Incident Room.description: Lead a team through detecting, containing and recovering from a school phishing incident.

Malware Lab.description: Investigate six infected devices, identify the malware and choose the right clean-up steps.

Phone Security Checkup.description: Give a pretend phone a security checkup, review its apps and strengthen eight settings.

Account Rescue.description: Spot an account takeover, put recovery steps in order and secure the account for the future.

Hotspot Hunter.description: Compare public Wi-Fi networks, check VPN claims and secure a pretend home router.

Cyber Shield Challenge.description: Team up to match cyber security terms and solve eight cases using everything you have learned.
